name: Dolby.io
tagline: Dolby.io provides cloud APIs for audio and video enhancement powered by AI. Its Media APIs offer noise reduction, loudness correction, dialogue enhancement, and dynamic range processing. Developers integrate it into conferencing apps, podcast platforms, and streaming services to deliver Dolby-quality audio at scale.
